claims.text: Large Language Models are susceptible to hallucinations where they generate plausible-looking but factually incorrect outputs.
Combining grammar-aware prompt engineering and formal methods decreases ambiguity in LLM prompts.
Combining grammar-aware prompt engineering and formal methods improves consistency in LLM outputs.
Combining grammar-aware prompt engineering and formal methods diminishes LLM hallucinations.

evidence.description: a critical challenge hindering their real-world deployment is their susceptibility to hallucinations, where they generate plausible looking but factually incorrect outputs.
by combining linguistic principles using GAPE and constructing a basis of formal structures using FMs, we could improve the LLM's ability to analyse language, decrease ambiguity in prompts
by combining linguistic principles using GAPE and constructing a basis of formal structures using FMs, we could... improve consistency in output
by combining linguistic principles using GAPE and constructing a basis of formal structures using FMs, we could... eventually, greatly diminish LLM hallucinations.

methodologies.name: Grammar-Aware Prompt Engineering and Formal Methods Synergy (GAPE-FM)
methodologies.description: A framework combining linguistic principles in prompt engineering with formal method structures to refine prompt logic and reduce hallucinations in LLMs.

limitations.text: LLMs are susceptible to hallucinations, producing plausible-looking but factually incorrect outputs that propagate misinformation and reduce user trust.

future_work.text: Foster interdisciplinary collaboration between linguists and AI experts to provide specialized LLM training emphasizing linguistic precision.
Implement iterative design and development procedures utilizing GAPE and FM principles to continuously enhance LLM performance.
